notes.title: Content Update - v0.9.0.7
notes.content:
Hello,

Today's update brings a new feature: Gear Ratio Setup. You can now adjust each of your cars' gear ratios, allowing you to choose between top speed or acceleration. You can find the gear ratio setup menu by clicking the gear button on top right of upgrade menu.

If you don't know how to setup your car, there is a little information text included with the gear ratio setup menu. You can also restore default values whenever you like. So don't be scared to mess up your car's setup :)

Hope you enjoy this new feature.

notes.title: Patch v0.9.0.5 + New Feature
notes.content:
Hello,

It's been a few weeks since last update. I wasn't able to find as much time as I wanted to improve the game. However, future patches will come quicker.

For this patch, I fixed flying cars bug, added a new feature, and improved game back-end (has no effect on game, just useful for upcoming patches).

+ You can now change interior color of your cars!
+ Flying cars bug fixed.
+ Backend improvements for future updates (no gameplay impact) .

Hope you enjoy the new feature.

notes.title: Minor Fixes - v0.9.0.4
notes.content:
Hello, today's patch brings 2 small improvements:

- You can now press escape to exit from menus and return back to original location in your garage. You can still use escape button to show exit menu if there are no menus on.
- Level-ExperienceBar overlapping in Profile Display (display above the garage door) now should be fixed.

Thanks.

notes.title: Patch v0.9.0.3
notes.content:
Greetings,

This patch brings more bugfixes. Following bugs should be fixed:
- Car Interior items not appearing bug fixed.
- Replaying tutorial allowed skipping steps without completing conditions. This should be fixed now.
- Resolution bug should be fixed by preventing player to select resolutions that are not supported by their system
- Upgrade missions now should not be completed without having enough upgrades

Thank you for your patience.

notes.title: Small Bugfixes v0.9.0.2
notes.content:
This small patch attempts to solve SteamVR opening bug when the game starts. The game does not currently support VR and this was not supposed to happen.

If you are experiencing following bugs, please report them, and explain how did they started to happen (if you remember). Hardest part of fixing bugs are finding what causes them :) So it would be very helpful if you include as much information as possible.

Upcoming Bugfixes:
- Mission Menu being unclickable
- Combo achievement bug
- Resolution bug
- Upgrade Mission completion bug

Sorry about the bugs and being slow to fix them. But I will try my best to address these issues as soon as possible :)
